translations.web: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.
translations.bsb: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
translations.kjv: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
translations.asv: I will make thee a perpetual desolation, and thy cities shall not be inhabited; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
